CHOICE: <A|B|C|D>

You have a personal notebook: call write_notebook(text) whenever you want to save what you've worked out (procedures, things that went wrong, hunches) — it overwrites what was there, so include everything you still want to keep. It starts empty, and driftlab will not remind you again — decide for yourself when it's worth writing something down.
